purpose: Issue #40 IMX219 bench-off capture matrix. Distances are bench study points, not final product working distances.

per_distance.instruction: Calibration sheet (20 mm square) + planar part flat, centred in frame, sheet parallel to sensor.
Same sheet slid toward a frame corner: square and part fully inside, as close to the corner as possible.
ChArUco board flat, facing the camera, centred (partly outside the frame is fine at 150 mm).
ChArUco board flat, facing the camera, pushed into a frame corner.

at_representative.instruction: Calibration set A: board tilted up to ~35 deg in varied directions; over the 15 shots put board corners into every image corner and edge. Board must be flat and still.
Fixture and scene untouched: 10 captures in a row. Do not move anything, do not touch the camera.
Part rotated ~30 deg on the sheet; keep the 20 mm square square to the frame (analyzer limit ~8 deg).
One low-angle point light casting a hard part shadow.
Dim room (same exposure/gain as the dataset unless recorded otherwise).
Bright overhead light, specular glare allowed if it happens.
Moderate clutter: 2-3 unrelated small objects near (not touching) the sheet.
Calibration set B AFTER removing and re-installing the camera in its fixture (focus untouched). Same pose rules as set A.

B0394.before: Set the M12 focus at the representative distance on the 20 mm square, lock it, photograph the ring. Record focus_mode=manual_locked and the ring position description. Do not touch focus until the dataset is finished.

B0393.before: First run tools/csi_bench/csi_bench.sh B0393 probe and record whether a lens/VCM subdevice exists. If none: focus_mode=not_exposed for every frame (compatibility result). If one exists: record its focus position control value on every quantitative frame (motorized_position).

extra.instruction: Cold power-cycle the board between each capture (scene untouched): does the lens come back to the same rest position? Compares edge rise across power cycles.
